title: The agent can draft the MRI request. A person still sends it.
friendlyTitle: The agent can draft the scan request. A person still sends it.
summary: On 16 November, OpenAI said computer-use agents for healthcare are available in ChatGPT for Healthcare, ChatGPT for Clinicians, and the API. They can move through existing software to draft orders, notes, and authorization requests. OpenAI says physicians rated 99% of 325 reviewed inbox tasks clinically safe, and 93% of 646 ratings very or extremely helpful.
friendlySummary: On 16 November, OpenAI said healthcare teams can use agents that click through the software they already have. The agent can draft an order, a note, or an insurance request. OpenAI says doctors called 99% of 325 reviewed inbox tasks safe, and 93% of 646 ratings very or extremely helpful.
whyItMatters: Those figures are OpenAI's, for GPT-6 Astra at maximum reasoning effort, not a result from your chart. A draft is not an order until a clinician sends it. Organizations have to turn computer use on, and protected health information needs an eligible service under a business associate agreement.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Those numbers are OpenAI's, for one model on one test, not a promise about your patient. A draft is not an order until a clinician sends it. A workplace has to switch the tool on, and private health details need the right privacy agreement.
